When the Republic attacks, they will get ''quite'' a surprise.|Mar Tuuk|audio=OurBlockadeIsImpenetrable-SOR.flac|}} '''Mar Tuuk''' {{Pronounced|mɑɹ tuk}} was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A shrewd tactician noted for his study of military history, he was charged by [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] with overseeing the Separatist [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tuuk commanded a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] ''[[Procurer]]'', deploying the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to thwart any attempt by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to liberate the world. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], Tuuk went up against [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his forces, luring them into a trap that destroyed [[Redeemer/Legends|one]] of Skywalker's three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and forced the remaining two to flee. After realizing that the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], Skywalker's flagship, had been present, Tuuk studied the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] history of accomplishments and began to respect him. Knowing that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would attempt another attack, Tuuk believed that should he defeat Skywalker, he would earn much prestige in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of his comrades in the Confederate [[Navy/Legends|Navy]]. Skywalker later returned to Ryloth aboard the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']], one of his two remaining [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and offered to surrender himself, his crew, and his ship in exchange for the transportation of medical and food supplies to the captive [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] natives on the planet below. However, a scan of the incoming ''Defender'' indicated that Skywalker was the only one aboard, and that its forward [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] were activated. Realizing that he had himself fallen into a trap, Tuuk abandoned the ''Procurer'' before the ''Defender'' collided with it in an explosion that obliterated both [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. The Separatist fleet, suddenly without a leader, was unable to counter the Republic attack and was subsequently destroyed, paving the way for the Republic to liberate Ryloth. ==Biography== ===Ryloth blockade=== {{Quote|Let's see what trickery the Jedi have planned for us.|Mar Tuuk, during the Battle of Ryloth|}} Mar Tuuk was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. A shrewd, veteran officer and a studier of military history, Tuuk served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming a trusted naval [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]'' In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], tasked Tuuk with commanding the Separatist [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world that had been occupied by Tambor and a force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Commanding from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] ''[[Procurer]]'',{{SWPM|set=Clone Wars Tactics|cardname=''Procurer'' ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship|link=http://www.miniaturetrading.com/img/miniatures/star-wars-pocketmodel-tcg/1192/big/ship-17.jpg}} Tuuk deployed his [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to keep [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces from penetrating the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and landing on Ryloth. As added insurance against any Republic or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attack, he opted to leave four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] in reserve, to be called upon when needed. [[File:Mar_Tuuk_datapad.png|thumb|left|250px|Tuuk studies about his adversary, General Skywalker.]] As Tuuk anticipated, the Republic launched an attempt to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the captive [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] on Ryloth. A force of three Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]—the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']], the [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']], and the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]—under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] arrived in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]] to destroy the blockade. As a [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|squadron]] of Republic [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], led by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], attempted to destroy the ''Procurer'' and the two ''Munificent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] in Ryloth's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Tuuk called upon the four frigates he had kept in reserve to enter the fray, springing the trap. The [[Warship/Legends|warships]]' combined complements of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] overwhelmed the Republic forces, destroying many Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and launching suicidal attacks on the three ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The ''Resolute'' and the ''Defender'' managed to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but the ''Redeemer'' was destroyed. Victorious, Tuuk reported on the engagement to Emir Tambor via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Despite the success, Tambor warned the Neimoidian captain not to underestimate Skywalker, whom Tuuk had deduced was leading the engagement due to the presence of Skywalker's flagship, the ''Resolute''. Intrigued by his encounter with the famed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Tuuk sought to know every bit of information that the Separatists had on him. Impressed with the Jedi's accomplishments, the Neimoidian hoped to gain prestige for defeating him. Though Tambor doubted the Republic would risk making a second offensive, as the Republic's forces were spread too thin throughout the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], Tuuk suspected Skywalker would return and decided to be prepared should the Republic renew the attack. Again, just as the Separatist captain had predicted, Skywalker returned to Ryloth aboard the damaged ''Defender''. However, Tuuk had failed to correctly predict why the Jedi had returned. Skywalker contacted Tuuk aboard the ''Procurer'', informing the Neimoidian that he was willing to surrender himself and his entire crew in exchange for food and medical supplies to be delivered to the captive Twi'leks on the planet below. Initially unbeknownst to Tuuk, Skywalker was the sole person aboard the ''Defender''; with the help of his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], he had set the damaged Star Destroyer on a collision course with Tuuk's Droid Control Ship. When the Captain was informed that a scan of the incoming [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] revealed that the Jedi was the only living being aboard, Skywalker told Tuuk that he could keep the ''Defender'', just before he and R2-D2 evacuated their doomed ship in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. [[File:Tuuk_Skywalker.png|thumb|right|250px|Mar Tuuk confers with Anakin Skywalker during the latter's "surrender."]] Realizing the danger he was suddenly in, Tuuk ordered all batteries to open fire on the incoming Star Destroyer. When the cannons were unable to destroy the damaged cruiser, Tuuk relinquished command of his flagship to a [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid 1 (Ryloth blockade)/Legends|battle droid]] and managed to likewise evacuate in an escape pod before the ''Defender'' collided into the ''Procurer'', destroying both warships. Suddenly leaderless, the droid commanders of the six ''Munificent''-class frigates were unable to defend themselves against the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing]] and V-19 Torrent starfighters launched from the newly-arrived ''Resolute''. The destruction of the Separatist blockade paved the way for the Republic's planetary assault force, and in time, the Twi'leks were liberated by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] force led by [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} ===Separatist dealings=== Some [[Time/Legends|time]] following the conclusion of the Ryloth engagement, Tuuk met with Count Dooku's representative, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The two traveled to the Neimoidian world of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] to conduct talks, only to be followed by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] seeking to uncover what Ventress was up to. After his meeting, Tuuk was confronted by the Jedi, who questioned him on the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin's]] recent actions. Following their conversation, the Jedi departed to continue his investigation, leaving the Neimoidian behind.{{TCWA|Card Commander}} Tuuk later became involved in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure's]] plot to captured several [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]] from the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and sell them on the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. The Neimoidian hired the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] criminal [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] to transport the shaaks aboard his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], and deliver them to Tatooine. The plot was uncovered by the Jedi Knight who had previously interrogated Tuuk on Cato Neimoidia, and the Knight proceeded to the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], where he captured Tuuk aboard his ''Munificent''-class star frigate. The Captain bargained for his release, supplying the Jedi Knight with knowledge of Ziro's involvement in the scheme. As it turned out, this was not the last encounter between Tuuk and the Jedi. On the trail of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], the Knight learned from a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang of pirates]] that his quarry had fled to Cato Neimoidia to meet with the Captain. In their third encounter, Tuuk surrendered and informed the Jedi that Bane had departed to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], a [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] near the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|His record shows that he is a great warrior. And I want him to know that it is ''I'' who has beaten him.|Mar Tuuk, regarding Anakin Skywalker|}} A veteran officer who had earned the trust of Count Dooku, Mar Tuuk was a capable [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commander and tactician who studied up on military history. Having prepared his blockade of Ryloth for a Republic assault, he lured the enemy into a false sense of hope, springing the trap when they were right where he wanted them. At Ryloth, this tactic saw the destruction of one Star Destroyer and the retreat of the remaining two. In the interlude between the Republic attacks, Tuuk analyzed his opponent, Anakin Skywalker, developing a respect for the general. The Neimoidian believed that, once he defeated Skywalker, he would become a celebrated commander in the Confederate [[Navy/Legends|Navy]]. However, he underestimated the Jedi's resolve and fell for Skywalker's own trap. Realizing he had been duped, and rather than attempt some last-minute maneuver when his cause was a lost one, Tuuk abandoned ship to save himself. A cool-headed yet vain Neimoidian, Tuuk took pride in his appearance, savoring it more than a well-developed battle plan.{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961fb7b789011fb859bb250005|text=Dataclip: Storm Over Ryloth|na=video file}} Tuuk possessed a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] as his personal weapon, and he wore [[Data goggles/Legends|data goggles]], equipped with a rotating scope, that connected him to many of his flagship's systems. His skin was [[Color/Legends|green]] in color, though it could change under stress. Tuuk stood at 2.09 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== [[File:Mar_Tuuk_Art_of_SWTCW.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Concept art of Mar Tuuk]] {{Quote|His costume is very much Neimoidian, a heavy-draped robe, but he's got military markings on him, a hat like Rommel, and these groovy club shoes with two-inch soles.|Designer [[Kilian Plunkett]]|''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''}} Captain Mar Tuuk first appeared in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," episode nineteen of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, and was voiced by [[Corey Burton]]. Although unnamed in the episode itself, he was given the name "Mar Tuuk" in the [http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode019.html "Storm Over Ryloth" episode guide] published on [[StarWars.com]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}} Concept art from both the [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] and ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' indicates that he was originally named "Martuk."{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}} Tuuk was named by Series Writer [[Henry Gilroy]] after Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]'s cat.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' Tuuk was originally supposed to die when his flagship was destroyed, but his life was spared because he proved to be an interesting character to [[George Lucas]] and the crew of ''The Clone Wars''. As a result, a scene was added showing him fleeing from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Procurer'', and a line given to a battle droid revealed that he had fled in an escape pod. However, the original version of events featuring Tuuk's death was later depicted in the young readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]'', conflicting the TV series.''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]'' Tuuk later appeared in the "Card Commander" mini-game found in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']],{{TCWA|Card Commander}} and he was an unlockable character in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] and [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] versions of ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' In addition to establishing Mar Tuuk's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as Neimoidia and providing a pronunciation for his name, a featurette regarding "Storm Over Ryloth" in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] DVD set reveals several details regarding the Neimoidian's creation. In the featurette, concept artist [[Kilian Plunkett]] compares Tuuk to [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]; in fact, Tuuk's original character model was that of Gunray's, but with a different hat, shoulder pads, and data goggles. However, Plunkett was not impressed with the design, which still bore a considerable resemblance to Gunray, so he made some changes to the concept, including giving Tuuk a "[[Wikipedia:Mick Jagger|Mick Jagger]], [[Wikipedia:Donald Rumsfeld|Donald Rumsfeld]]"–like mouth. The featurette also introduces some confusion regarding the Neimoidian's rank—it refers to Tuuk as both a general and an admiral. An image of Tuuk, taken from "Storm Over Ryloth," was included on several [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreens]] in the Cato Neimoidia level of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' A War Portrait of Tuuk was to be included with information on the Separatists in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', but it was among the content cut before the book's publication.{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}} ===Homages to ''The Last Starfighter''=== {{Quote|What should we do?''"
"''We die.|A battle droid and Tuuk, in a scene cut from the final episode|}} Elements of Mar Tuuk's character are references to the [[1984]] science fiction film [[Wikipedia:The Last Starfighter|''The Last Starfighter'']], a favorite of Dave Filoni's. The rotating scope device on Tuuk's data goggles, as well as his command chair, was inspired by the gear of a Ko-Dan fleet officer, Lord Kril, from the film. In the original version of the episode, with the ''Defender'' about to ram the ''Procurer'', a panicked battle droid asks Tuuk, "What should we do?" The Neimoidian merely replies "We die," before the Star Destroyer rams his flagship. This whole scene was intended as another homage to ''The Last Starfighter'', but neither the dialogue nor Tuuk's death made it into the final episode when Lucas decided to spare the captain. This dialogue was used for Tuuk's non-[[canon]] death in the young readers book ''The Battle for Ryloth''. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Mar Tuuk|imagecat=Images of Mar Tuuk}} *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] *{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} {{1st}} *''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|Appears in holoscreen}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] and [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] versions only}} ==Sources== *{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961fb7b789011fb859bb250005|text=Dataclip: Storm Over Ryloth|na=video file}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}} {{1stID|Mar Tuuk}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}} *{{InsiderCite|110|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season One Episode Guide, Part Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season One Episode Guide, Part Two}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' *{{SWMiniCite|set=Galaxy at War|pack=Captain Mar Tuuk}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.4|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.4]] *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' *{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep119|text="Storm Over Ryloth" -
